title: Synesthete Watson who saw and felt tastes

tellings.quote: so this one guy everything that he tasted uh Wat a guy name Watson I think everything he tasted with his mouth he also uh saw things

plain: A cognitive scientist named Don Hoffman, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, tells of a man he thinks was named Watson who had synesthesia, a condition where the senses blend. He says everything Watson tasted, he also saw and felt as shapes. Hoffman uses it to argue that our brains show us only a slice of what is out there.
